deleteDialog.singleDescription: This permanently deletes <name>{{name}}</name>. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.withDocumentsDescription_one: This permanently deletes <name>{{name}}</name> and the <count>{{count}}</count> document inside it. This cannot be undone.
deleteDialog.withDocumentsDescription_other: This permanently deletes <name>{{name}}</name> and all <count>{{count}}</count> documents inside it. This cannot be undone.

gitTokens.title: Manage Git tokens
gitTokens.intro: Create a token to mirror content from an external Git repository.
gitTokens.credentialsDescription: Use these credentials to push content to your collection. The password is only shown once.
gitTokens.gitLabDescription: These steps are specific to GitLab. Other Git providers may use different setup flows.
gitTokens.gitLabStep1: Open your GitLab project and go to Settings > Repository > Mirroring repositories
gitTokens.gitLabStep2: Click the “Add new” button to open the setup flow
gitTokens.gitLabStep3: Set Git repository URL to the remote URL above
gitTokens.gitLabStep5: Set Authentication method to Username and Password
gitTokens.gitLabStep7: Set Password to the password above
gitTokens.gitLabStep8: Select Mirror specific branches and enter “{{branch}}”
gitTokens.gitLabStep9: Click the “Mirror repository” button to finish
gitTokens.gitLabStep10: Click the “Update now” button to trigger an initial push

tree.emptyWritable: No files yet. Use + to create or upload skills or files.
